description: Independent explicit cases for static/portfolio.js::buildComparisonSeries. Expected values are hand-computed from the contract and from the immutable Phase-3A fixture data; they are never produced by calling the implementation.

provenance.capture_method: DEV-ONLY, outside the committed tests: extracted the real legacy loadSimEquity/loadMonthlyEquity/loadDailyCoreEquity plus withLiveToday/mddOf from /tmp/opencode/phase3b-baseline/static/index.html, ran them with deterministic API/LightweightCharts/DOM stubs and a fixed Date, and recorded setData payloads. The committed tests only read the pinned values below; they never need /tmp.

allowed_differences: Daily Sim and DCA benchmark: legacy plotted raw intraday `at` timestamps (duplicate timestamps possible) and the Daily Sim chart never appended/replaced the live valuation on the DCA overlay. The shared comparator standardizes every curve to one point per UTC day (last input row wins) and applies the provided live mark. Values for the same UTC day's last recorded mark are unchanged.

Daily-Core and Monthly benchmark overlays: legacy already deduped by day and applied live. The shared comparator produces the same values; the legacy raw intraday path is intentionally not reproduced.

Pct mode: legacy `toPct` fell back to the USD equity value when contributed <= 0, silently mixing units. The shared comparator omits those pct points and emits a warning. USD mode is unchanged and keeps the actual equity/contribution values.
Legacy x-axis: Sim/DCA used epoch-second timestamps; the shared comparator uses UTC YYYY-MM-DD date strings on every curve. This is presentation-only.
